title: Keep checks from becoming the target
statement: Keep the checks from becoming the target: attack the judge with a deliberate cheater, rotate the probes each round, and hold a frozen set back to catch gaming.
example: A re-probe over many shuffles decertified 72 ordering items that had been certified against a single seeded shuffle.
detail: The course-plan training skill's anti-Goodhart discipline rotates probe seeds and personas every round, holds out one probe family per promotion, uses judges from unseen model families, re-anchors them to human judgment periodically, and red-teams the gauntlet itself (`ti-courseplans-audit/skills/train-teacher/SKILL.md`). Its standing reminder is its own gate bug: ordering items had been certified against one seeded shuffle, and a re-probe over many shuffles decertified 72, one of them at exactly 1.000 (`ti-courseplans-audit/skills/course-red-team/references/finding-taxonomy.md`). Attack the judge before tuning against it, to find what it passes by default.

evidence.quote: Rotate probe seeds and personas every round; hold out one probe family per promotion; judges from unseen model families
red-team the gauntlet itself with `course-red-team` (our own single-shuffle gate bug is the standing reminder that the gate can be the bug).
sequence items certified against one seeded shuffle; multi-shuffle re-probe decertified 72 incl. one exact 1.000
